subject: Mobile Development
title: Offline Mode and Sync
description: A short lesson to help you apply Offline Mode and Sync.

hook.text: You lose signal on the subway. A good app keeps working; a bad one shows a blank screen.

buildup.text: Offline-capable apps cache data locally and queue changes until connectivity returns.

discovery.text: Conflict resolution matters: what happens if you edit offline and someone else edits online?

twist.text: Building reliable offline sync is one of the hardest problems in mobile development.

climax.text: Great offline support is invisible when it works and infuriating when it doesn't.

punchline.text: Good apps work even without signal.

quiz.question: What is a challenge of offline sync?
options: Resolving conflicts when both sides changed data
